Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE professional individual character dossier art sheet for GLIMBLEHOP, matching the given canon image. The attached group sheet is REFERENCE ONLY: extract ONLY the specified individual, do NOT draw the other cast. Warm high-end handcrafted 3D animated fantasy, cream paper, fine brown typography, clean spacious graphic layout. Keep ONE IDENTICAL CHARACTER, face, costume, color and accessories across every pose. Title "TISH — CHARACTER STUDY". Landscape sheet. Upper large band: THREE full-body standing views aligned on same baseline and scale, labels "FRONT", "RIGHT SIDE", "BACK". Middle band: ONE larger expressive waist-up three-quarter portrait labelled "3/4", and TWO close-up material/identity details. Lower band: SIX separate readable head-and-shoulder expressions with exact labels CALM, JOY, WORRY, DETERMINED, SHEEPISH, RELIEF. Every expression must visibly differ through brows/eyelids/mouth/head angle, not six identical smiles. Clean visible hands, feet and ears, no cropping of full bodies. No scenery, no story paragraphs, no other cast, no extraneous logos. This is a development sheet, not a final animation-ready asset.

For goblins only: smooth intact elegant pointed ear rims everywhere EXCEPT Tish's specified right bite. Do NOT add random ear damage. No mirrored asymmetry. Rear views are actually rear, not repeated front with head turned. Side views genuinely profiles. Keep facial style adult/child/species as specified. Natural warm neutral lighting in all views, readable silhouette and fine material detail.
